title: Agent Fuel
summary: Fund a capped token vault an AI agent can spend from, then turn each paid call into on-chain reputation.
what: Agent Fuel has two Anchor 0.31.1 programs. credit_vault holds an owner's tokens for one agent and enforces per-transaction, hourly and lifetime caps plus a service whitelist. reputation lets services record paid usage with single-use receipts, leave feedback, and compute an agent score.
app_note: The page at /dapps/agent-fuel/ is the generic IDL-driven console for credit_vault; the reputation IDL is at /dapps/agent-fuel/reputation-idl.json. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/agent_fuel.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/agent-fuel/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. The lab already ran a spend and recorded it as reputation.
try_steps.see: Vault BeADSYia… holds 600_000; the agent profile score is 360.

diagram: owner --create_vault/deposit/update_policy--> vault+policy; agent --spend--> service ATA; service --record_payment(receipt)--> agent_profile+link; service --give_feedback--> feedback; anyone --compute_score--> score.
innovation: Spending caps protect the owner, and single-use payment receipts stop a service from inflating an agent's reputation with repeated feedback.
exercises: Which PDA makes a receipt single-use?
